notes.title: TAOLU Livestream tonight!
notes.content:
During Steam's NextFest you'll be able to see TAOLU in action. We'll be playing the game on friday 10th of February and on Sunday.
Take a look to the game and ask the developers any question you may have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625024/2a2b7e49f3e533e5f4b63f97474899b6cb795e8e.png[/img]

Come visit us and join the VR fun.

notes.title: TAOLU is free during the Steam VR Fest
notes.content:
From July 18 to July 25 you can Play TAOLU for free during the Steam VR Fest.
The game is still in pre-release and being improved, but it's plenty of fun, using the legendary wooden dummy to train Kungfu like a real master.

Have fun, get high in the world rankings and leave your feedback to the developers, so they can polish the game experience for future releases.
Easy to learn, hard to master and a lot of fun. Play TAOLU now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625024/6417eaf83bcbc81d372eca615a7bb0b4b29101bd.png[/img]
